# `shipment-return` commands

## `shipment-return query`

List shipment returns, newest first, by shipment, customer, status or date.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/shipment-return.query` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow shipment-return query --shipment 1001 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "shipment-return query", "input": {"shipment": "1001"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shipment` | `--shipment` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only this shipment's returns. |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only this customer's returns. |
| `status` | `--status` | literal["returned", "voided"] \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `date_from` | `--date-from` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `date_to` | `--date-to` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 50 | minimum 1; maximum 500 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/shipment-return.query`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].number` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].status` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].date` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].shipment_number` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].sales_order_number` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `rows[].customer_name` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `rows[].reopen` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].quantity` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].value` | object | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].value.amount` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].value.currency` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `rows[].value.minor_units` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `total` | integer | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json

  "rows": [],
  "total": 1
}
```

## `shipment-return void`

Void a shipment return with a reason: its units leave stock again at the return date and wait in Shipped Not Invoiced; a return that cancelled them on the order un-cancels them. Refused when the order no longer has them to ship (shipped again or billed since).

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Additional resources | customer-work: standard |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/shipment-return.void` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow shipment-return void 1001 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "It never came back" --dry-run --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:


| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
